context.issue_title: ISS-0205: webhook_deliveries.status written lowercase but CHECK requires UPPERCASE

task.description: Step 2 — write a fix design artefact. The fix is a single-source-file change: src/webhook/dispatcher.zig has 8 SQL string literals (lines 88, 172, 207, 251, 295, 371, 406, 440) that violate the webhook_deliveries.status CHECK constraint defined in migration 085. Write src/design/iss205-webhook-status-case.md (Type E prose) describing: (1) the contract mapping (pending→PENDING, success→DELIVERED, failed→FAILED, exhausted→FAILED); (2) the exact 8 SQL edits in a table (line, before, after, rationale); (3) verification: which integration tests will pass and why (iss205 3/3, iss106, ext02; iss601 not affected); (4) no schema change, no new endpoint, no test addition required (existing tests already exercise the rows). Do NOT write implementation code. Do NOT add a regression test — the existing 3 failing iss205 tests are the regression tests.
acceptance_criteria: src/design/iss205-webhook-status-case.md created with sections per docs/guides/backend_developer_guide.md §6 (Context, Contract, Design, Verification)
All 8 SQL edits listed with before/after
Mapping table shows source_lc → CHECK_domain value with rationale for each
No implementation code in the design (Type E prose only)

result.summary: Design artefact written; 8 SQL edits enumerated (4 INSERT/SELECT lineage + 3 UPDATE + 1 INSERT enqueue) for ISS-0205 / GH #400. Linter passes (no BLOCKER/MAJOR). All 8 sites are in src/webhook/dispatcher.zig (lines 88, 172, 207, 251, 295, 371, 406, 440). Mapping table defines pending->PENDING, success->DELIVERED, failed->FAILED, exhausted->FAILED per migration 085 Step 3. Out-of-scope sites (line 419 webhook_subscriptions PAUSED; lines 68/154/297 webhook_subscriptions ACTIVE) explicitly excluded. Verification section lists iss205/iss106/ext02/iss601 expected verdicts; no new test added because existing ISS-205 TC1/TC2/TC3 already exercise the affected paths.
